text.text_excerpt: Our stay here was good. The hotel staff is incredibly friendly and helpful. We stayed in a room around the pool courtyard, second level. There's a few French style seating and tables just outside the rooms in the pool courtyard for hanging out, eating, etc. The room we stayed in was relatively small, but decent. This is especially if you're just using the facilities to rest your head after a day of hanging out in the French quarter. This hotel definitely has some history to it. Though this may not be as important to some people as it is to me, it didn't have an old building smell which was great. They keep the facility generally clean and fragrant for the most part. They do serve compleme...

All the staff are very nice. The parking out back is nice. Love the French Quarter type brick in the room. Adequate continental breakfast, but wish there were apples and bananas as well as oranges and grapefruit. The bath tub looked like it needed a deep clean the hot water is on the right. What would keep me from coming back, since I go to bed at 10:00 p.m. Is the the drunks and lovers making noise till 1 a.m. If you go to bed after reveling at the French Quarter till 3 a.m., it was pretty quiet in the morning. There is a $100 refundable deposit and parking is $25 a day that is not mentioned on the internet, during the booking process.

This place does not disappoint! We had a courtyard room overlooking the pool - gorgeous! The breakfast buffest aimed to please! The fleur-de-lis waffles, breakfast sandwiches, local coffee was superb! Found a deal on Hotel Tonight and it was well worth it!
